connector.name: Genudo
connector.registryDescription: Build & manage Genudo AI agents for any messaging channel - pipelines, integrations, knowledge.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package genudo-mcp-client. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the genudo-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GENUDO_TOKEN
env.description: Your Genudo token (API Keys & Tokens → Create token, mcp:use scope), sent as a Bearer token.

env.name: GENUDO_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL for self-hosted Genudo instances. Defaults to https://api.genudo.ai.

env.name: GENUDO_ALLOW_INSECURE_SSL
env.description: Set to true to allow self-signed certificates (local development only).
